part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `lookupKey` (src/script.c:660): the no-touch exception for TOUCH checked `c->cmd`, where `c` is `server.current_client` — during a script that's the outer client whose command is EVAL, so TOUCH inside a script was wrongly given `LOOKUP_NOTOUCH`. 

The fix (matching upstream valkey PR #1499) checks `server.executing_client->cmd` instead, which points at the command actually being executed (the inner TOUCH within a script):

```c
if (c && c->flag.no_touch && server.executing_client && server.executing_client->cmd->proc != touchCommand)
    flags |= LOOKUP_NOTOUCH;
```

Verified: `unit/introspection-2` passes including the new "TOUCH alters the last access time of a key in no-touch mode" test, and `unit/scripting`, `unit/functions`, `unit/keyspace`, `unit/expire` all pass with no regressions.
